question: Should OpenClaw add persistent per-group and per-topic Telegram UI override keys for streaming and acknowledgment reactions, or keep these controls at account/channel scope?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive configuration contract, not a repair to an already documented broken behavior; the branch’s implementation also combines it with an unrelated cron policy change.

options.title: Sponsor scoped Telegram overrides
options.body: Adopt the feature direction, then request a rebased narrow PR with generated metadata, explicit precedence documentation, and real Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep account-level UI controls
options.body: Decline the added per-room config surface and close this proposal after preserving any separately desired cron fix.

recommendation.title: Sponsor scoped Telegram overrides
recommendation.body: Adopt the feature direction, then request a rebased narrow PR with generated metadata, explicit precedence documentation, and real Telegram proof.
